scope: Linux native communication acceptance, initial 24 and final 25 leaves per profile; no complete CI claim
limitations: No direct observation of native MDS waiting_locks before local wait expiry.
Local Wait cancellation does not send remote cancellation; the interrupt is a separate explicit request.
SETFILELOCK safe completion is in-memory completion, not journal durability.
Wire inode Version and MaxSize may change with capability bookkeeping; content checks use ChangeAttr and native statx.version.
Messenger resume counters are retained observations, not application request resubmissions.
